verdict.rationale: Twilio documents answering incoming calls, gathering caller input and recording calls without a person picking up, which covers automated answering and message-taking. A hands-on user confirms voicemail-to-webhook with transcription, and Twilio markets 'Conversational AI' and agents 'human or AI'. However, nothing shows a conversational AI voice agent actually handling the call, or a documented transfer to a live human. Missing for 10: an evidenced AI voice agent answering calls, a documented warm or cold handoff to human agents, an end-to-end AI receptionist workflow, and independent corroboration of AI call handling.
